passage:
uncertainty — 不确定性
It is about a community that chose to act despite uncertainty.

drainage — 排水系统
'This will only work if we also improve the drainage system.

maintenance — 维护；保养
However, it required regular maintenance, and not everyone was convinced.

compromise — 妥协；折中方案
Elena Marsh proposed a compromise.

pilot — 试点的；试验性的
The town would build a short section of living shoreline as a pilot project, and it would also raise the lowest part of the existing wall.

functional — 功能性的；实用的
It was not beautiful, but it was functional.

monitoring — 监测；监控
Instead, the planning group published a short report with three recommendations: continue monitoring, set aside money each year for maintenance, and review the plan every two years.

evidence — 证据
But they created a process that allows them to change their minds as new evidence appears.
